name: Custom content video block
purpose: Sells the bespoke content studio with a headline, a watch CTA and a video thumbnail beside an explanatory paragraph.
description: Legacy green-theme hairline block (left and bottom borders only) in container-large: a header with a 64px serif H2 (max 42rem) and a green pill button, then a bordered 2-column grid of a 16:9 video lightbox thumbnail (right hairline) and a 20px paragraph. One column at <=767, with the paragraph moved above the thumbnail at <=479. Used once, on /content/custom-content.
